patterns: Avengers: Doomsday and Doctor Doom owned the day: DiscussingFilm's 'Kevin Feige says that Doctor Doom is not a Tony Stark variant' hit 2,846,300 views, the top post on the board, and the 'New look at Doctor Doom' image did 1,679,550 with 59,755 likes (the most-liked post of the day). The Russo Brothers' 'gothic character' quote added 644,908, Shang-Chi vs Gambit 649,266, and the officially released ENDGAME: ENCORE ending 1,640,553.

Casting gossip with a number in it travels: 'Robert Pattinson was offered more money & only a 3-film commitment' for James Bond did 2,596,220, and Xochitl Gomez saying she struggled to find work after joining the MCU did 1,645,564.

First looks and trailers stayed strong: ANSWR (horror about an AI chatbot) 2,123,271 with 45,317 likes, Pixar's GATTO first trailer 1,995,342, MACCA & FRIENDS 1,475,740, Cursula in Disney's HEXED 1,010,104, and the AVATAR: SEVEN HAVENS poster 912,558.

Games crossed over again: new GTA 6 in-game footage 1,475,162 with 50,427 likes, WOLFENSTEIN 3 officially in the works 1,215,292, the Sonic 35th-anniversary short 727,896, and The Game Awards on Disney+ 404,232.

Bad reviews spread: Johnny Depp's EBENEZER at 50% on Rotten Tomatoes did 908,314 on DiscussingFilm and 437,084 on FilmUpdates. Timely calendar news also landed: a new FRIDAY THE 13TH movie with Steve Miner returning did 518,773 on Friday the 13th itself.

Smaller accounts: CinemaTweets1's 'One of the Best War Films in the History of Cinema' did 962,463, far above its usual range, while its Paper Tiger posts sat at 5K-20K. ATRightMovies' best were the ROCKY II training montage (76,874) and the BIG piano scene (45,669); its 'Which film was your introduction to...' prompts held 11K-19K. FilmUpdates' Variety highest-paid TV stars list did 618,951.
narrative_synthesis: Doctor Doom ran the day: Kevin Feige's 'not a Tony Stark variant' quote hit 2,846,300 views on DiscussingFilm, the top post on the board, and the new Doom image pulled 59,755 likes, the most of any post. Pattinson's Bond deal (2,596,220), the ANSWR first look (2,123,271) and Pixar's GATTO trailer (1,995,342) filled out the top. Games kept crossing over (GTA 6 footage 1.48M, Wolfenstein 3 1.22M), and Johnny Depp's EBENEZER at 50% on Rotten Tomatoes showed bad reviews travel too (908K). CinemaTweets1's war-film post (962,463) was the smaller-account outlier. @RealEmirHan had no originals in the window.
